li.label: biological neophyte
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} went through assimilation willingly. The old body is still alive in {PAWN_possessive} memory, and {PAWN_pronoun} is only learning to live in the new one.

li.label: form-wash survivor
li.description: {PAWN_nameDef} was assimilated by force: {PAWN_possessive} body was dissolved and rebuilt in a foreign shape. This scar on {PAWN_possessive} mind will never fully heal.
